p0.original: In that rude state of society, in which there is no division of labour, in which exchanges are seldom made, and in which every man provides every thing for himself, it is not necessary that any stock should be accumulated, or stored up before-hand, in order to carry on the business of the society. Every man endeavours to supply, by his own industry, his own occasional wants, as they occur. When he is hungry, he goes to the forest to hunt; when his coat is worn out, he clothes himself with the skin of the first large animal he kills: and when his hut begins to go to ruin, he repairs it, as well as he can, with the trees and the turf that are nearest it.
p0.zh: 在这种无礼的社会状态下,没有分工,很少进行交换,每个人都为自己提供一切东西,因此没有必要为了进行社会事业而积累任何股票,或先行储存.每个人试图通过自己的产业提供 自己偶尔的希望,当它们发生。饥馑时,去林中打猎;衣冠磨损后,自己用他所杀的第一只大动物的皮衣:当他的小屋开始倒塌时,他用最接近的树木和地皮来修理,也尽他所能.

p1.original: But when the division of labour has once been thoroughly introduced, the produce of a man's own labour can supply but a very small part of his occasional wants. The far greater part of them are supplied by the produce of other men's labour, which he purchases with the produce, or, what is the same thing, with the price of the produce, of his own. But this purchase cannot be made till such time as the produce of his own labour has not only been completed, but sold. A stock of goods of different kinds, therefore, must be stored up somewhere, sufficient to maintain him, and to supply him with the materials and tools of his work, till such time at least as both these events can be brought about. A weaver cannot apply himself entirely to his peculiar business, unless there is before-hand stored up somewhere, either in his own possession, or in that of some other person, a stock sufficient to maintain him, and to supply him with the materials and tools of his work, till he has not only completed, but sold his web. This accumulation must evidently be previous to his applying his industry for so long a time to such a peculiar business.
p1.zh: 但当劳动分工一度被彻底引入时,一个人自己劳动的产物可以供应,但是他偶尔需要的一小部分.其大部由其他男子劳力的产物提供,他用该产物购买,或用该产物的价钱自行购买,何谓同物. 但是,在他自己劳动的产物不仅完成,而且出售之前,这种购买是不能进行的. 因此,必须储存各种货物,储存在某个地方,足以维持他,并向他提供他的工作材料和工具,直到至少能够实现这两个事件为止。 一个织工不能完全适用于他的特殊业务,除非有手前储存在某个地方,或者在他自己手中,或者在某个其他人手中,一个足以维持他的股票,并且向他提供他的作品的材料和工具,直到他不仅完成了,而且卖掉了他的网络. 这种积累显然必须先于他将他的产业应用到这样一个奇特的行业上这么长一段时间。

p2.original: As the accumulation of stock must, in the nature of things, be previous to the division of labour, so labour can be more and more subdivided in proportion only as stock is previously more and more accumulated. The quantity of materials which the same number of people can work up, increases in a great proportion as labour comes to be more and more subdivided; and as the operations of each workman are gradually reduced to a greater degree of simplicity, a variety of new machines come to be invented for facilitating and abridging those operations. As the division of labour advances, therefore, in order to give constant employment to an equal number of workmen, an equal stock of provisions, and a greater stock of materials and tools than what would have been necessary in a ruder state of things, must be accumulated before-hand. But the number of workmen in every branch of business generally increases with the division of labour in that branch; or rather it is the increase of their number which enables them to class and subdivide themselves in this manner.
p2.zh: 由于积存的积存,在事物性质上必须先于劳动分工,所以劳动的分数只能随着积存的分数增加而增加. 随着劳动力的日益细分,同样数量的人能够工作的材料数量大大增加;随着每个工人的操作逐渐减少到更简便的程度,为了便利和避免这些操作而发明了各种新机器。 因此,随着劳动分工的推进,为了让同等数量的工人能够不断就业,必须先积累同等数量的规定,并比在更粗鲁的状态下需要的更多材料和工具。 但是,每个业务部门的工人人数一般随着该部门的分工而增加;或者说,正是由于工人人数的增加,他们才得以以这种方式分类和细分。

p3.original: As the accumulation of stock is previously necessary for carrying on this great improvement in the productive powers of labour, so that accumulation naturally leads to this improvement. The person who employs his stock in maintaining labour, necessarily wishes to employ it in such a manner as to produce as great a quantity of work as possible. He endeavours, therefore, both to make among his workmen the most proper distribution of employment, and to furnish them with the best machines which he can either invent or afford to purchase. His abilities, in both these respects, are generally in proportion to the extent of his stock, or to the number of people whom it can employ. The quantity of industry, therefore, not only increases in every country with the increase of the stock which employs it, but, in consequence of that increase, the same quantity of industry produces a much greater quantity of work.
p3.zh: 由于积蓄对于继续这种劳动生产力的极大改善以前是必要的,因此积蓄自然会导致这种改善.雇用其库存来维持劳动的人,必定希望以尽可能大量地生产劳动的方式雇用该库存。 因此,他努力使工人得到最适当的就业分配,并向他们提供他能够发明或买得起的最好的机器。 在这两个方面,他的能力一般与他的库存量或它能够雇用的人数成比例。 因此,工业数量不仅随着使用该工业的库存增加而增加,而且由于这一增加,同样数量的工业生产了更多的工作。

p4.original: Such are in general the effects of the increase of stock upon industry and its productive powers.
p4.zh: 一般而言,这是库存增加对工业及其生产力量的影响。

p5.original: In the following book, I have endeavoured to explain the nature of stock, the effects of its accumulation into capital of different kinds, and the effects of the different employments of those capitals. This book is divided into five chapters. In the first chapter, I have endeavoured to shew what are the different parts or branches into which the stock, either of an individual, or of a great society, naturally divides itself. In the second, I have endeavoured to explain the nature and operation of money, considered as a particular branch of the general stock of the society. The stock which is accumulated into a capital, may either be employed by the person to whom it belongs, or it may be lent to some other person. In the third and fourth chapters, I have endeavoured to examine the manner in which it operates in both these situations. The fifth and last chapter treats of the different effects which the different employments of capital immediately produce upon the quantity, both of national industry, and of the annual produce of land and labour.
p5.zh: 在以下一书中,我努力解释股票的性质、股票积累到不同种类资本的影响以及这些首都不同就业的影响。 此书分为五章. 在第一章中,我努力说明股票中哪些是个人或一个伟大社会自然分裂出来的不同部分或分支。 第二,我努力解释货币的性质和运作,认为是社会总存量的一个特殊分支。积累成资本的股票,可以由其所属人使用,也可以借给其他他人. 在第三和第四章中,我努力审查它在这两种情况下的运作方式。 第五和最后一章讨论了资本的不同就业立即对本国工业以及土地和劳动力年产量产生的不同影响。
